rationale: The stock gapped up ~20% on the open and has already sold off from the session high of $14.02 to $13.13, placing price at only 3.8% of today's range and essentially at the session low. The bid-ask spread is 106.6 bps on a $13 stock, making the cost of entry prohibitively wide relative to the ATR of $0.07 on 5-minute bars. With price pinned near the low, no clear directional structure to trade against, and extremely unfavorable spread-to-ATR ratio, the risk/reward does not justify entry in either direction.
